summary: git options: extra refspec to fetch, remote name, the required repo URL (avoid embedded credentials), separate git dir, single-branch clones, and ssh_opts passed via GIT_SSH_COMMAND with BatchMode enforced.
questions: How do I check out a commit not on any branch?
Should I put a password in the git repo URL?
How do I pass custom SSH options to git?
How do I clone only a single branch?
How do I keep the .git directory somewhere else?

answer_card.title: git parameters (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `repo` (required, alias `name`): git/SSH/HTTPS URL. **Don't embed credentials**; use SSH keys or a credential helper.
- `refspec`: extra ref to fetch (needed for unreachable SHA-1s), e.g. `refs/meta/config`
- `remote` (origin)
- `single_branch` (no)
- `separate_git_dir`
- `ssh_opts`: passed via `GIT_SSH_COMMAND`; `BatchMode=yes` always added
